nodes.label: Capital Management & Corporate Actions
nodes.summary: Capital management activities including share buybacks, dividends, capital reduction, financial assistance, schemes of arrangement, and corporate actions requiring shareholder approval.

nodes.label: Share Buybacks
nodes.summary: Listed companies may repurchase their own shares subject to Listing Rules requirements, including general mandate, announcement, and disclosure obligations.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 10.06 — Share Buyback Requirements
nodes.summary: Share buybacks must be approved by shareholders and comply with the general mandate provisions.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 10.07 — Buyback Disclosure
nodes.summary: Listed companies must announce share buybacks within the prescribed timeframes.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.114 — Share Buybacks
nodes.summary: Companies may repurchase their own shares with shareholder approval.

nodes.label: Dividends
nodes.summary: Dividends must be declared by the board and approved by shareholders. Interim and final dividends are subject to Listing Rules requirements.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.36 — Dividend Requirements
nodes.summary: Dividends must be declared by the board and approved by shareholders at a general meeting.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.120 — Dividend Distributions
nodes.summary: Companies may only distribute dividends out of profits.

nodes.label: Capital Reduction
nodes.summary: Capital reduction requires special resolution and court confirmation. The reduction must not be prejudicial to creditors.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.141 — Capital Reduction
nodes.summary: Capital reduction requires special resolution and court confirmation.

nodes.label: Financial Assistance
nodes.summary: Listed companies must comply with restrictions on providing financial assistance for the purchase of their own shares.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 10.08 — Financial Assistance Restrictions
nodes.summary: Listed companies must not provide financial assistance for the purchase of their own shares without shareholder approval.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.275 — Financial Assistance Restrictions
nodes.summary: Companies must not provide financial assistance for the purchase of their own shares without shareholder approval.

nodes.label: Schemes of Arrangement
nodes.summary: Schemes of arrangement require court order and shareholder approval. The scheme must be approved by a majority in number representing 75% in value.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.81 — Schemes of Arrangement
nodes.summary: Schemes of arrangement require court order and shareholder approval at a meeting.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.673 — Schemes of Arrangement
nodes.summary: Schemes of arrangement require court order and approval by a majority in number representing 75% in value.

nodes.label: Rights Issues / Placings / Open Offers
nodes.summary: Capital raisings by way of rights issue, placing, or open offer require shareholder approval and compliance with Listing Rules.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 7.08 — Rights Issues
nodes.summary: Rights issues must be offered to existing shareholders on a pro-rata basis.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 7.12 — Placings
nodes.summary: Placings must comply with the requirements for non-rights issues.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 7.19 — Open Offers
nodes.summary: Open offers must be offered to existing shareholders on a pro-rata basis.
